title: ADR Decision Record v1
description: One record per architecture decision, appended once to specs/ADRs/decisions.jsonl (v0.5.0 specs-canon closure, operator ruling 2026-08-28). A decision moves — the whole record relocates, never copies — to specs/ADRs/_superseded/superseded.jsonl the moment it is superseded; its id is never reused. `id` is monotonic and gap-free across BOTH files together. Any agent may append a `status: proposed` record; ONLY the operator flips `status` to `accepted` (specs/ADRs/AGENTS.md's operator-only acceptance law) — `accepted` requires a non-null `measured_by` (a decision nobody can measure is not a principle, it is prose).

id.description: Zero-padded 4-digit sequence number, monotonic and gap-free across decisions.jsonl + _superseded/superseded.jsonl together — never reused, never re-numbered.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp this record was appended (or last moved, for a superseded record).

status.description: proposed: any agent may author. accepted: operator-only, requires measured_by. rejected: operator decision, no consequence elsewhere. superseded: the record has moved to _superseded/superseded.jsonl.

context.description: What forces make this decision necessary — the problem, not the solution.

decision.description: "We will …" — the choice, stated as a commitment, not a discussion.

measured_by.description: The existing mechanical check that proves this decision holds (an import-linter contract, a contract test node id, a doctor check code, a ratchet script). Required (non-null) when status is accepted.

supersedes.description: Id (NNNN) of the record this one supersedes, or null.

amends.description: Id (NNNN) of the record this one amends, or null.

examples.title: Features depend on ports, not adapters
examples.context: Features need I/O (git, filesystem, subprocess) but must stay unit-testable without real I/O.
examples.decision: We will define a Protocol in core/protocols/ for every I/O boundary a feature needs, and inject a concrete infrastructure/ adapter at the composition root (container.py) — a feature module never imports infrastructure directly.
examples.consequences:
+ features are testable with fakes, no real I/O in unit tests
- one extra indirection layer per I/O boundary
